Page 1540 
Ryoncil (remestemcel-l-rknd) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-669274  
Guideline Name 
Ryoncil (remestemcel-l-rknd)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
8/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Ryoncil  
Approval Length 
1 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming diagnosis of acute graft 
versus host disease (aGVHD)  


=== PDF PAGE 1541 ===
Page 1541 
 
AND 
 
2 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming one of the following:  
 
 2.1 Patient has Grade C or D aGVHD involving the skin, liver, and/or GI tract  
 
OR 
 
 2.2 Patient has Grade B aGVHD involving the liver and/or GI tract with or without 
concomitant skin disease  
 
AND 
 
3 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming disease is steroid refractory 
as defined by progression of aGVHD within 3 days or no improvement within 7 days of 
consecutive treatment with 2 mg/kg/day methylprednisolone or equivalent  
 
AND 
 
4 - Patient is 2 months of age to less than or equal to 17 years of age  
 
AND 
 
5 - Patient has not received any second line therapy to treat aGVHD (e.g., Jakafi, 
mycophenolate mofetil, etc.)  
 
AND 
 
6 - Both of the following;  
 
 6.1 Prescribed by a provider at a transplant center with expertise in gene therapy  
 
AND 


=== PDF PAGE 1542 ===
Page 1542 
 
 6.2 Prescribed by one of the following:  
• 
Hematologist/oncologist  
• 
Bone marrow transplant specialist  
• 
Specialist with expertise in the diagnosis and management of steroid-refractory 
aGvHD (SR-aGvHD)  
 
Product Name:Ryoncil  
Approval Length 
1 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming one of the following:  
 
 1.1 Both of the following:  
• 
Patient has had a partial or mixed response to current Ryoncil treatment course  
• 
Patient has not received more than 12 infusions  
 
OR 
 
 1.2 Patient is experiencing a recurrence of GvHD after complete response with Ryoncil 
therapy  
 
AND 
 
2 - Both of the following:  
 
 2.1 Prescribed by a provider at a transplant center with expertise in gene therapy  
 
AND 
 
 2.2 Prescribed by one of the following:  


=== PDF PAGE 1543 ===
Page 1543 
• 
Hematologist/oncologist  
• 
Bone marrow transplant specialist  
• 
Specialist with expertise in the diagnosis and management of steroid-refractory 
aGvHD (SR-aGvHD)
